description: Execute a subgraph of nodes multiple times, once for each item in a list.

inputSchema.description: Any input data containing an array to iterate over.

configFields.name: listPath
configFields.label: Array Path to Iterate
configFields.description: Path to the array in the upstream input (e.g. input.pdfFiles).

configFields.name: nodesInLoop
configFields.label: Nodes to Include (Comma-separated IDs)
configFields.description: The nodes that should run for each item. Must form a valid subgraph.

configFields.name: resultNode
configFields.label: Result Node ID
configFields.description: The node whose output will be collected into the final results array.
